== Biography ==
John was born in 1805. He was the son of [[Glasgow-2600|John Glasgow]] and [[Glenn-5657|Isabel Glenn]]. He passed away in 1858.

John married Isabella Glenn on 16 August 1827 in Belmont, Goshen Township, Belmont, Ohio, United States.<ref>
